# Proximity Measurement

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:ProximityMeasurement`](gmeow-ProximityMeasurement.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/ProximityMeasurement>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A measurement of distance, dissimilarity, or proximity between two entities, expressed as a scalar quantity in a reference frame that declares its metric kind. The [`observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) is the entity measured from; [`gmeow:proximityTo`](../properties/gmeow-proximityTo.md) names the target entity; [`gmeow:observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) points to the scalar value. Computed by the solver ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)), not asserted in the OWL core.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:ProximityMeasurement`](gmeow-ProximityMeasurement.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Measurement`](gmeow-Measurement.md). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to reify a measured distance, dissimilarity, or proximity between two entities in a frame that declares its metric kind.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting the computed distance as a plain triple — proximity is computed by the solver from the metric ([Principle 12](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-12)).

### How to use

- Mint [`ProximityMeasurement`](gmeow-ProximityMeasurement.md), set [`gmeow:observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) (the from-entity) and [`gmeow:proximityTo`](../properties/gmeow-proximityTo.md) (the target), and point [`gmeow:observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) at a [`ScalarQuantity`](gmeow-ScalarQuantity.md) in a frame with [`gmeow:hasMetricKind`](../properties/gmeow-hasMetricKind.md).

### Examples

- ex:dist a [`gmeow:ProximityMeasurement`](gmeow-ProximityMeasurement.md); [`gmeow:observedFeature`](../properties/gmeow-observedFeature.md) ex:a; [`gmeow:proximityTo`](../properties/gmeow-proximityTo.md) ex:b; [`gmeow:observationResult`](../properties/gmeow-observationResult.md) ex:scalar.
